name: Eternal Ecstasy
source:
The protagonist attained a strange book and summoned an unusually beautiful creature.
This woman, Liza, said she came to help him and started offering very intimate service.

[From [url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE140359.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
主人公得到一本奇怪的书，召唤出一名异常美丽的生物。这个名叫丽莎的女人说自己是来帮助他的，并开始提供非常亲密的服务。

[译自[url=https://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE140359.html]DLsite English[/url]]
